**Mi Band 7 / 8 / 9:** use `mi-band-192x490.png` as the background and put the clock inside
the screen: x 32, y 59, 127 × 228 px.

## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.3333 (spec 0.3356), screen at the exact 240:432 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://fdn2.gsmarena.com/vv/pics/sonyericsson/se-aino-01.jpg (official image, the open phone cut out, white margin added)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://fdn2.gsmarena.com/vv/pics/sonyericsson/se-aino-01.jpg); specs: [gsmarena.com](https://www.gsmarena.com/sony_ericsson_aino-2810.php).
